fact: On 17 February 2026 the ARP Committee on Rights and Freedoms heard the sponsors of the draft organic data protection law, which the chair said regulates the use of AI, creates a right not to be subject to a solely automated decision and requires impact assessments for high-risk processing, and which provides for an Instance of personal data protection with a chamber for financial penalties.
title: ARP : audition autour du projet de loi sur la protection des données personnelles
